svg.title: ChalkTalk deployment architecture
svg.desc: A browser connects to services on an OVHcloud VM. A Node.js worker runs jobs, Hocuspocus and Yjs provide CRDT collaboration, the services use Supabase PostgreSQL and object storage, and the API and worker connect to the Resend API over HTTPS.
